FB04-047.text: [Activate:Main] Place the top 3 cards of your deck into your Drop: Draw 1 card. Then, play up to 1 Battle Card with a cost of 4 or less and ≪Saiyan≫ in its special traits from your Drop.

FB09-082.name: Son Goku/Vegeta
FB09-082.text:
[On Play] Add up to 1 card from your life to your hand.
[Activate:Main][Once Per Turn] Switch this card to Active Mode. Then, this card can't attack for the turn.

FP-051.name: Son Gohan: SH
FP-051.text: [On Play] If your Leader has <SH> in its card name, choose up to 2 Battle Cards with costs of 4 or less in your opponent's Battle Area and KO them.

FB09-091.name: Veku
FB09-091.text:
[Evolve] pay 0 energy: <Son Goku/Vegeta> with a cost of 2 or more.
[Activate:Main] Place this card into your Drop: Play up to 1 <Son Goku> and up to 1 <Vegeta> -- both with ≪Another World≫ in their special traits -- and with a combined cost of 3 or less from your Drop in Rest Mode. Then, you can't play <Veku> for the turn.

FB07-097.name: Dragon ball
FB07-097.text:
[Permanent] This card can't attack, and if your life is at 4 or less, this card gets +5000 power.
[Activate:Main] Switch this card to Rest Mode: Draw 1 card.
[Awaken]When you have 7 cards with ≪Dragon Ball≫ in their special traits in your Drop, draw 1 card. The, flip this card over.

back.name: Shenron
back.text:
[Permanent] This card can't attack.
[Activate:Main] Switch this card to Rest Mode: Play up to 1 Battle Card with a cost of 7 or less from your Drop and flip this card to its front side. Then, return all cards from your Drop to their owner's deck. Shuffle your deck.

FB04-110.name: Son Goten: GT
FB04-110.text: [Auto][Your Turn] When this card is used in a combo from the Battle Area, choose up to 1 of your opponent's Battle Cards with a cost of 4 or less and return it to its owner's hand.

FB11-093.name: Beerus
FB11-093.text:
[Super Combo]
[Auto][Opponent's Turn] When you use this card in a combo from your hand, this card gets +10000 combo power.

SB02-053.name: Frieza
SB02-053.text: [On Play] If your Leader has ≪Frieza's Army≫ in its special traits, play up to 1 non-<Frieza> Battle Card with a cost of 2 or less and ≪Frieza's Army≫ in its special traits from your hand.

FB11-098.name: Ipana
FB11-098.text: [Activate:Main][Once Per Turn] If your Leader has 3 or more Ki, choose your <Bardock> Leader or up to 1 <Bardock> in your Battle Area and it gets +5000 power for the turn.

FB07-120.name: Dragon Radar
FB07-120.text: [Activate:Main] Look through your deck and life, reveal up to 1 card with ≪Dragon Ball≫ in its special traits and add it to your hand. Then, shuffle your deck and life.

FB03-039.name: Son Gohan: Adolescence
FB03-039.text: [On Play] If you have 7 or fewer cards in your hand, choose up to 2 of your opponent's Battle Cards with costs of 3 or less and place them at the bottom of their owner's deck.

ST01-071.name: Vegeta
ST01-071.text:
[On Play] You will not lose the game for the turn.
[When Attacking] Remove all 3 or more Ki from your <Vegeta> Leader and add all of your life to your hand: This card gets +10000 power for the battle for each Ki removed by this skill. Then, if your opponent's life is at 2 or more, place 1 of your opponent's life into its owner's Drop.

FB06-093.name: Witch's Abode
FB06-093.text:
[Field]
[On Play] Add up to 1 card from your life to your hand. Then, choose up to 1 Rest Mode Battle Card with a cost of 4 or less in your opponent's Battle Area and KO it.

FB08-116.name: Veku
FB08-116.text: [On Play] If your Leader is <Gogeta> and you don't have an energy marker, add 1 card from your life to your hand. Then, you place 1 energy marker.

FB09-086.name: Trunks: Youth
FB09-086.text: [When Attacking] If you have <Vegeta> in your Drop, this card gets +5000 power for the battle.

FP-045.name: Tien Shinhan
FP-045.text: [On Play] If your Leader has ≪World Tournament≫ in its special traits, play up to 1 <Tien Shinhan> with a cost of 4 from your hand. Then, you can't play <Tien Shinhan> for the turn.

FB01-036.name: Trunks: Future
FB01-036.text:
[When Attacking] Draw 1 card.
[Awaken] When your life is at 4 or less, draw 1 card. Then, flip this card over.

back.name: Trunks: Future
back.text:
[When Attacking] Draw 1 card.
[Activate:Main][Once Per Turn] Choose up to 1 Battle Card with a cost of 3 or less and return it to its owner's hand.

FS11-08.name: Son Gohan : Adolescence
FS11-08.text:
[On Play] If your Leader is <Son Goku>, draw 1 card.
[When Attacking] Discard 1 card from your hand: This card gets +10000 power for the battle.

FB10-073.name: Boujack
FB10-073.text:
[When Attacking] Draw 1 card.
[Awaken] ( Can be activated during [activate main/battle] if the conditions are met.) When your life is at 4 or less or this card has 2 or more Ki, flip this over.

back.name: Boujack
back.text:
[When Attacking] Draw 1 card.
[Activate:Main] [Once Per Turn] Reduce this card's Ki by 2 and KO 1 Battle Card in your Battle Area with a cost of 2 or more: Switch this card to Active Mode.

FB05-049.name: Son Goku
FB05-049.text:
[When Attacking] Draw 1 card.
[Awaken]( Can be activated during [activate main/battle] if the conditions are met.) When your life is at 3 or less, draw 1 card. Then, flip this card over.

back.name: Son Goku
back.text:
[Permanent][Your Turn] This card gets +10000 power.
[End of Your Turn] Discard 1 card from your hand: If your life is at 2 or less and you have 7 or less energy, add the top card of your deck to your life.

FB06-081.name: Danima: DA

FB04-092.name: Majin Buu: Evil
FB04-092.text:
[When KO'd] Draw 1 card.
[Activate:Main][Once Per Turn] KO up to 1 of your Battle Cards.

FB10-121.name: Vegito
FB10-121.text:
[Evolve] pay 2 energy: <Son Goku>, <Vegeta>, or <Vegito> with a <Potara> under them.
[On Play] Draw 3 cards. Then, discard 1 card from your hand.
[Auto] When your card deals damage or KO's your opponent's Battle Card in battle, if your opponent's life is at 2 or less, place the top 15 cards of your opponent's deck into their owner's Drop.

FB05-062.name: Bulma
FB05-062.text: [On Play] Look at 3 cards from the top of your deck, reveal up to 1 card with ≪Planet Namek≫ in its special traits and add it to your hand. Place the rest at the bottom of your deck in a random order.

FP-053.name: Zamasu/Goku Black
FP-053.text: [On Play] If your Leader is <Goku Black>, add up to 1 card from your life to your hand. Then, during this turn, the next time you use <Goku Black>, reduce the cost by 1.

FP-008.name: Son Goku
FP-008.text: [On Play] Add up to 1 card from your hand to your energy.

FB07-092.name: Mecha Frieza/King Cold
FB07-092.text:
[Blocker]
[On Play] If this card was played from your life, add the top card of your deck to your life.

FB03-061.name: Cell
FB03-061.text:
[On Play][Your Turn] If your Leader is <Cell>, choose all cards with costs of 6 or less in your opponent's Battle Area and add them to their owner's energy in Rest Mode.
[When KO'd] Place 1 card from your energy in its owner's Drop: Play this card from your Drop in Rest Mode.

FB05-007.name: Son Goku
FB05-007.text: [When Attacking] Choose up to 1 Battle Card in your opponent's Battle Area and it gets -10000 power for the turn.

FB01-074.name: Android 16
FB01-074.text:
[Blocker]
[When KO'd] Play up to 1 <Son Gohan: Childhood> with a cost of 6 from your Drop.

FP-027.name: Son Goku

[Blocker]
[On Play] If you placed a card from your energy into your Drop during this turn, draw 1 card.

[When Attacking] Discard 1 card from your hand and place the top 2 cards of your deck into your Drop: Draw 1 card.

[Blocker]
[On Play] Add up to 1 card from your life to your hand.

[When Attacking] This card gets +1 Ki. Then, you place 1 energy marker.

FB04-099.name: Blind Spot Absorption
FB04-099.text:
[Activate:Battle][Opponent's Turn] Your cards that are in a battle get +20000 power for the battle.
[Activate:Battle] pay 1 energy: Draw 1 card. Then, choose up to 1 of your opponent's Battle Cards and switch it to Rest Mode.
